message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on a crankshaft position sensor. I recall such sensors being classified in 9031.80, as measuring or checking instruments, and Section XVII Note 2 excludes Chapter 90 goods from Section XVII. Alternatively, 8543.70 or 9026 (instruments for measuring flow, level, pressure or other variables of liquids or gases) could apply, but those don't fit. 8708.99 is also excluded because Chapter 90 articles fall outside Section XVII.

The ruling I have in mind (NY N298 or similar) put a crankshaft position sensor under 9031.80.8085, "Other instruments, appliances and machines: Other: Other." I believe the 9031.80 subheading was split into 9031.80.80 for other and 9031.80.8085 for other still. The statistical suffix for others is 9031.80.8085, and I am fairly confident that is right.

Another possibility is 8543.70.9960 for a sensor that functions as a transducer, but the ruling on the magneto-resistive crankshaft sensor went to 9031.80.8085.
